conceptual_change: Incorporate the ATR-based filter logic requiring a 14-period ATR exceeding 1.05 times its 20-period moving average into the execution engine to validate entry conditions.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous attempt (BTC_1h_008) failed execution because the logic was proposed without the engine-level capability to calculate the ATR-based filter. This change ensures the indicator logic is implemented as a requirement for testing the volatility-gated entry strategy.
